content: If $y=y(x)$ is the solution of the differential equation, $\sqrt{4-x^2} \frac{\mathrm{~d} y}{\mathrm{~d} x}=\left(\left(\sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)\right)^2-y\right) \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right),-2 \leq x \leq 2, y(2)=\frac{\pi^2-8}{4}$, then $y^2(0)$ is equal to ___________.
